entries.title: AI Balance extension built and installed
entries.content:
## AI Balance Extension

**Path:** `c:\Users\sulaco\Desktop\Projects\vscode-extensions\ai-balance`

**What it does:** Shows DeepSeek and OpenRouter API balance in the VS Code status bar.

### Files
- `src/extension.ts` — Activation, commands, auto-refresh timer
- `src/balanceProvider.ts` — Fetches balances from DeepSeek and OpenRouter APIs
- `src/statusBarManager.ts` — Status bar item with formatted display
- `package.json` — Config for API keys, URLs, refresh interval

### Configuration (settings.json)
- `aiBalance.deepseek.apiKey` — DeepSeek API key
- `aiBalance.deepseek.apiUrl` — Default: https://api.deepseek.com
- `aiBalance.openrouter.apiKey` — OpenRouter API key
- `aiBalance.openrouter.apiUrl` — Default: https://openrouter.ai/api
- `aiBalance.refreshInterval` — Auto-refresh in seconds (default 300, 0 to disable)

### Commands
- `AI Balance: Refresh Now` — manual refresh
- `AI Balance: Configure API Keys` — opens settings

### Status bar display
- `DS:$0.1234` — DeepSeek balance
- `OR:$5.00` — OpenRouter remaining credits
- Click to refresh
- Tooltip shows detailed info

### Build
- `npm run compile` — `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json`
- `npx vsce package` — creates .vsix

### API endpoints
- DeepSeek: `GET /user/balance` — returns `balance_infos[0].total_balance`
- OpenRouter: `GET /api/v1/auth/key` — returns `data.usage` and `data.limit`

entries.title: AI Balance v0.2.0 — settings restructure, currency conversion, enable/disable
entries.content:
## AI Balance v0.2.0 — major update

### Changes from v0.1.0
1. **Settings restructured** — własna sekcja `AI Balance` w ustawieniach z czytelnym podziałem na providers/display
2. **Per-provider enable/disable** — `aiBalance.providers.deepseek.enabled` i `aiBalance.providers.openrouter.enabled` (boolean)
3. **Currency conversion** — nowy moduł `currencyConverter.ts` używa darmowego API Frankfurter (https://api.frankfurter.dev) do przeliczania USD na inne waluty
4. **Wybór waluty** — `aiBalance.display.currency` z dropdown (USD, EUR, PLN, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF, CNY, CZK, DKK, HUF, NOK, SEK)
5. **Show/hide status bar** — `aiBalance.display.showInStatusBar` (boolean)
6. **Nasłuchiwanie zmian configu** — extension reaguje na zmiany ustawień bez przeładowania okna

### Nowe ustawienia
```
aiBalance.providers.deepseek.enabled   — true/false
aiBalance.providers.deepseek.apiKey    — klucz API
aiBalance.providers.deepseek.apiUrl    — URL (domyślnie https://api.deepseek.com)
aiBalance.providers.openrouter.enabled — true/false
aiBalance.providers.openrouter.apiKey  — klucz API
aiBalance.providers.openrouter.apiUrl  — URL (domyślnie https://openrouter.ai/api)
aiBalance.display.currency             — USD/EUR/PLN/... (dropdown)
aiBalance.display.showInStatusBar      — true/false
aiBalance.refreshInterval              — sekundy (0=wyłączone)
```

### Currency API
- Uses https://api.frankfurter.dev/latest?base=USD (free, no key needed)
- Cache 1h
- Falls back to USD if conversion fails

entries.content:
## AI Balance v0.2.0 — final code review

### Files
```
ai-balance/
├── .vscodeignore
├── README.md
├── icons/
│   ├── deepseek.png
│   ├── deepseek.svg
│   ├── openrouter.png
│   └── openrouter.svg
├── package.json
├── src/
│   ├── balanceProvider.ts
│   ├── currencyConverter.ts
│   ├── extension.ts
│   └── statusBarManager.ts
├── tsconfig.json
└── out/ (compiled JS)
```

### Issues found and fixed during review
1. **package.json** — added `scripts` (compile, package, watch) and `repository` field
2. **package.json** — fixed currency description (still mentioned old exchangerate.host)
3. **statusBarManager.ts** — tooltip said "Click to refresh" but command opens settings

### Potential problems (not fixed, by design)
1. **API key in settings.json** — stored in plain text in VS Code settings (standard for VS Code extensions, but users should be aware)
2. **DeepSeek endpoint** — `/user/balance` may change; no official docs confirmation
3. **Exchange rate API** — open.er-api.com is free but rate-limited (cached 24h mitigates this)
4. **No error notifications** — errors only shown in tooltip, no toast/notification to user
5. **fetch()** — uses global `fetch` (available in Node 18+, VS Code 1.85+ uses modern Electron)
6. **Status bar color** — cannot customize icon colors, only monochrome Codicon supported

### Architecture
- `extension.ts` — activation, commands, config listener, auto-refresh timer
- `balanceProvider.ts` — fetches balances from DeepSeek and OpenRouter APIs
- `currencyConverter.ts` — USD conversion via open.er-api.com (24h cache)
- `statusBarManager.ts` — status bar item with formatted display and tooltip

### Potential Problems (by design / known)

2. **DeepSeek endpoint `/user/balance`** — niepotwierdzony w oficjalnej dokumentacji
3. **open.er-api.com** — darmowe, ale może mieć rate limiting (cache 24h)
4. **Brak powiadomień o błędach** — błędy tylko w tooltipie, nie ma toastów
